mostWorthwhile.text: Following the filtered sample through glucose and water recovery was most worthwhile. It showed why filtration alone would lose useful materials and how the tubule returns some to the blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the collecting passages and then the ureters was clear, but those steps felt predictable after the recovery sequence.

surprise.text: The filter let glucose and water through alongside urea while retaining blood cells and large proteins. That made the need for recovery concrete.

arbitrary.text: My initial attempt to join the kidney vessels directly to the filters failed, although the pieces seemed physically related. The automatic connection to the body clarified the intended order.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see another body system connected, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than the mostly predictable sequence here.
